within_list_cues.TB01: Rationale error plus a consensus cue. Choice A (2x² − 3x + 1) does not follow from its stated error: treating f(2x) as 2f(x) gives 2f(x) = 4x² − 6x + 1, so f(x) = 2x² − 3x + 1/2. With A as written, every choice ends in + 1, C shares x² with D and −3x with A, so C is the consensus pick. Use A = 2x² − 3x + 1/2. One test value (the given rule at x = 1 gives f(2) = −1; A 3, B 41, C −1, D −7) removes every distractor, which is normal for a determine-the-function item.
within_list_cues.TB05: Test values remove every distractor (f(3) = 15 > 5 removes C; f(7) = 5.4 > 5 removes B; f(10) = 4.5 < 5 removes D). Inherent to an MC solution-interval item (as with CLD-SAT-M-000840). Acceptable.
within_list_cues.TB09: Identity item: x = 1 gives 26 and only D gives 26 (A 8, B 14, C 20). All choices agree at x = 0. Acceptable for an equivalent-expression item.
within_list_cues.TB16: Mild irrelevant givens: the vertex x-coordinate 2 and the horizontal shift 3 do not affect the count. This is part of the point (C's error is about translations), so it is acceptable.
within_list_cues.TB17: Consensus cue. 'a > 0' appears in C and D, and '0 < b < 1' appears in B and C, so C is the one choice that shares a part with two others. Replace with a 2 × 2 grid: A a < 0 and 0 < b < 1; B a < 0 and b > 1; C a > 0 and 0 < b < 1 (key); D a > 0 and b > 1. Each distractor then is one specific wrong inference (A and B ignore f(1) > 0; D ignores f(2) < f(1)).
